resources.name: Finnis-Sinclair potential for Nb-H by Gillan et al.

access.notes: Potential form and parameters described in Gillan, Phys. Rev. Lett. 58, 563 (1987) and Christodoulos & Gillan, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 3, 9429 (1991). The agent must implement the potential in LAMMPS (e.g., via pair_style table or custom pair style).
